page_title: LEC 1-1 BOL | Lecce v Bologna 03/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's it for today, Daniele Doveri has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+10' Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
90+10' 1 - 1 Goal! Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Lukasz Skorupski into left side of the goal.
90+9' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+8' It’s a PENALTY to Lecce after the VAR review!
90+7' There's a break in play and referee Daniele Doveri must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Lecce using VAR. This could be interesting!
90+6' One of the Lecce players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
90+5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lecce comes to nothing.
90+2' Bologna are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
90+2' The corner is swung in but Bologna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+1' Nikola Moro (Bologna) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Corner kick. Bologna will have an opportunity.
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
90' The referee shows a yellow card to Nicola Sansone (Lecce). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
90' The resulting set piece from Bologna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

89' He should have scored! Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom left corner is pretty weak and Wladimiro Falcone makes an easy save.
88' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
85' Thiago Motta has decided to make a change. Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) replaces Dan Ndoye.
84' Marin Pongracic (Lecce) has tested the patience of referee Daniele Doveri and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

80' Bologna slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
79' Surely that's handball by one of the Bologna players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
79' Lecce quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
77' Here is a change. Gabriel Strefezza is going off and Roberto D'Aversa gives the last tactical orders to Pontus Almqvist (Lecce).
77' Here comes a substitution. Hamza Rafia (Lecce) is brought on as a substitute for Ylber Ramadani.
76' A rebound spins to Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
73' Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
73' A clumsy foul by Remo Freuler (Bologna) and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle.
71' Wonderful movement by Bologna. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
68' 0 - 1 Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) scores a goal from the resulting free kick, sending it into the top right corner. What a strike that is, absolutely fantastic!
67' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
67' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alexis Blin (Lecce) is coming onto the pitch as Remi Oudin cannot continue after picking up an injury.
63' Substitution. Nicola Sansone (Lecce) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Lameck Banda walks off.
58' The game has come to an end for Alexis Saelemaekers. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna).
58' Thiago Motta prepares a substitution. Sydney van Hooijdonk is replaced by Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna).
58' The referee allows time for a substitution. Michel Aebischer will be replaced by Remo Freuler (Bologna).
58' Thiago Motta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nikola Moro (Bologna) replacing Giovanni Fabbian.
57' It is time for a substitution. Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) is on for Nikola Krstovic.
56' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
55' Lameck Banda (Lecce) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
54' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) picks up an injury.
53' Bologna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
52' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) was quite harsh and Daniele Doveri didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
51' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lecce.
48' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' It seemed like Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniele Doveri had an easy-decision to make.
42' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.

41' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom right corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Wladimiro Falcone, who tips the ball around the post.
40' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Lameck Banda (Lecce).
37' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.

36' The most active player in today's match is definitely Lameck Banda (Lecce). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!

36' Great solo effort by Lameck Banda (Lecce) as he beats two defenders before unleashing a low drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper is ready and makes a decent save.
33' Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
32' Bologna seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

31' Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but his shot missed the target close to the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
29' Lameck Banda (Lecce) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
28' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
27' Total attempts – 4:2.
26' Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.

24' That was a nice football moment. Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the roof of the net. Lukasz Skorupski guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
23' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
22' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) makes a strong challenge and Daniele Doveri blows for a foul.

20' Sydney van Hooijdonk (Bologna) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
18' Remi Oudin (Lecce) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
17' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) tries to find Nikola Krstovic, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
15' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle after Stefan Posch (Bologna) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
14' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The linesman signals a throw-in for Lecce.
13' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
12' Daniele Doveri blows the whistle, Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) is penalised for a foul.
10' Lecce work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
10' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) connects with the free kick and produces a header goalwards which is well blocked. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about that one.
10' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
9' Half-chance! Dan Ndoye (Bologna) plays a pass into the box, but Wladimiro Falcone reacts well to snuff out the attack.
8' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) trips an opposition player and Daniele Doveri signals a foul.

6' Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Daniele Doveri with no other option than to blow for a foul.
4' The corner from Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) is intercepted by the defence.

3' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) unleashes a close-range volley towards the middle of the goal, but his effort is thwarted by the keeper, and the score remains unchanged. Lecce force their opponents to concede a corner.
3' Lecce take a short corner kick.
2' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Now Lecce have a corner.

1' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Bologna are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Bologna will kick the game off.
Daniele Doveri is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
Show lineups
Hello and welcome to our live text commentary! We will provide you with instant updates of everything that happens in the match. The starting lineups will be announced very soon.
